name: Heritage
summary: The 2026 site, cleaned up: banner, left menu, page, right menu. Laptops stack both menus on the left; phones get a Menu button.

name: Masthead
summary: Closest to sigmod.org: one menu bar whose entries open the 2026 groups as dropdowns, a hero card on the homepage, and a side column with the current section.

name: Handbook
summary: Like conference documentation: one sidebar holds all eight groups as folding lists and stays put while you scroll. Best when the site has many pages.

name: Landing
summary: The homepage leads with when, where and what's next, plus one card per group. Inner pages show their group's pages as buttons. Phones scroll the section tabs sideways.

name: Proceedings
summary: The lightest: one centered column, a printed-programme header, a single line of section links, and the full site map in the footer. No banner image.
